newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan delays sale of power plant till December.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan delays sale of power plant till December.

text.p: Pakistan's Privatisation Division said on Thursday it had postponed the sale of a 26 percent stake in the state-owned Jamshoro power plant to a strategic investor to December from October.
"The bidding for Jamshoro will now take place in December," Privatisation Minister Naveed Qamar told Reuters.
He said the government needed more time to complete technical reports, adding that six companies had started financial evaluation of the 880-megawatt power station.
Jamshoro will be the second power plant to be privatised by Pakistan following the sale of a strategic stake in the 1,600-MW Kot Addu plant to Britains' National Power Plc in June.
